Additionally, the umbrella shaft appears to pass ambiguously through the group of monkeys without clear grounding or connection to the handle held by the front figure. Despite these structural/physics quirks, the visual quality is high.
key_defects: Physics violation: Bird balanced impossibly on the thin umbrella tip/ferrule.
